# Memo

**Test fixture.** A copy of Octipus's `with-store` plugin template, used by
this repository's tests of the per-user store. It is never published here.

Remember short texts for the user who asks, and recall them. Each user's
memos are kept by Octipus in the plugin's store (`store: {}`, the default
5 MB per user), never in the data directory, which every user of the
install shares.
